about: The chapter 1 playtest of 2026-11-18/19 (log v28), measured on the v28 build it was played on: the player's runs against the "you" bot's mirrors of them (same map, seed, Armory, card setup and draft picks, 12 dice), the player's saves and tension per wave, the scorecard's Best moment against the tension peaks and saves, and the Battery run's clutch nuke. Made by tools/v3/bot-fit/playtest.ts (runs) and fit.ts --fun (pooled). See docs/design/v3-ch1-kesh.md and v3-ch1-marrow.md, "After the playtest".
lostByWave: Per wave. The review file's lostByWave is cumulative: Kesh lost 1 on wave 8, 0 on wave 9 and 2 on wave 10 (4 in all, 0/0/1 in the boss rounds); Marrow 2 on wave 10 and 1/0/1; Battery 1 on wave 2, 1 on wave 6 and 4 on wave 7.

clutchNuke.note: pause note at step 6546 (wave 3, 28.6 s): "Now that was a clutch nuke"

nuke.board: rack 0 of 6; a guided missile 0.6 s from impact, a stealth bomber 1.8 s, drones 2.3 s and 3.3 s
nuke.after: board clear; no ship lost in the next 9 s

clutchNuke.detector: Not caught as built (saved 0 on 6 of 6 rolls): in the branch without the grab, the nuke stays on the water and the warm bot grabs it itself on its first step. With the new opt-in `gone` (funOfLog option: that branch has no such pickup) it is a nuke save, 1 ship on 6 of 6 rolls (all causes 1.17).
